stories.title: 物流网究竟要建什么？三个问题说清楚

en.title: What Exactly Should the Logistics Network Build? Three Questions Clarified
en.summary: China's logistics network is one of six major infrastructure projects being developed alongside water networks, power grids, computing networks, and communication systems. The logistics network supports activities ranging from grocery shopping and parcel delivery to factory supply chains and international trade.

stories.title: US wraps up military mission in Iraq, giving Baghdad room to strengthen China ties

en.title: US wraps up military mission in Iraq, giving Baghdad room to strengthen China ties
en.summary: The United States has concluded its military mission in Iraq as of September 30, potentially allowing Baghdad to pursue broader international partnerships. Analysts note this may benefit Chinese commercial and energy interests, though China is unlikely to assume the US security role in the region.

en.summary: China's foreign exchange reserves stood at 3.4003 trillion dollars at end-September, with various asset prices facing pressure from anticipated U.S. Federal Reserve interest rate increases.

en.title: People's Bank of China Continues Gold Purchases for 23 Consecutive Months

stories.title: 长三角铁路2026年国庆假期发送旅客逾2770万人次 日均增幅逾5%

en.title: Yangtze River Delta Railways transport over 27.7 million passengers during 2026 National Day holiday with daily increase exceeding 5%
en.summary: The Yangtze River Delta railway network transported more than 27.7 million passengers during the 2026 National Day holiday period, with daily average exceeding 3.95 million passengers, representing a 5% increase compared to the previous year. October 1st set a new single-day record with 4.427 million passengers.

stories.title: ByteDance heads first SCMP Plus Going Global 100 ranking

en.title: ByteDance heads first SCMP Plus Going Global 100 ranking
en.summary: ByteDance ranks first in a new SCMP Plus Going Global 100 ranking that assesses mainland Chinese companies' overseas expansion efforts. The ranking evaluated over 2,000 companies and ranked ByteDance ahead of Foxconn, Shein, and BYD.

stories.title: More global investors eye Chinese equities, ending 4-year underweight run, bank says

en.title: More global investors eye Chinese equities, ending 4-year underweight run, bank says
en.summary: Global investors have increased their allocation to Chinese equities from underweight to benchmark-neutral positioning since June, driven by attractive valuations and artificial intelligence opportunities. This shift ends years of reduced investment but does not signal strong bullish sentiment.

stories.title: DBS Hong Kong and Manulife Hong Kong mark 10 years of partnership with HK$1 million donation to support healthcare workers’ wellbeing

en.title: DBS Hong Kong and Manulife Hong Kong mark 10 years of partnership with HK$1 million donation to support healthcare workers' wellbeing
en.summary: DBS Hong Kong and Manulife Hong Kong are donating HK$1 million to a healthcare support center to commemorate ten years of their bancassurance partnership. The collaboration has focused on helping customers manage their wealth and protection needs.

stories.title: Hong Kong banks grow cautious on One Stanley mortgages amid investigation

en.title: Hong Kong banks grow cautious on One Stanley mortgages amid investigation
en.summary: Banks in Hong Kong are adopting a cautious approach to mortgages for the luxury One Stanley development while construction defect allegations are investigated. The uncertainty is affecting the super-prime property market's recovery.

stories.title: Hong Kong tech index to harness fast-growth companies in bid for better performance

en.title: Hong Kong tech index to harness fast-growth companies in bid for better performance
en.summary: Hong Kong's stock index compiler will add 10 fast-growing companies with at least HK$500 million in annual sales to its technology benchmark. The reform aims to revitalise the Hang Seng Tech Index, which has underperformed global peers and missed gains from artificial intelligence trends.
